name: Hayate Kisaragi
source:
After graduating at the top of his class from the special educational institution, the Academy, which has produced many outstanding talents,
he inherited his late grandfather’s trade and became a detective.

Although his classmates lamented it as a waste of talent, he himself drifts through each day without concern.

[b]“No way. Give it up. We’re forever just second-rate, shabby detectives on the outskirts.”[/b]

[Translate from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1340684]Getchu[/url]]
